subject: biology
title: Control and Continuation
welcome_lead: Meet the nervous and reproductive systems that control your body and make new life.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on nervous and reproductive body systems.
final_note: You now know how the body senses, responds and continues the next generation.

concepts.def: Brain, spinal cord and nerves that send signals.
Special cell that carries nerve signals.
Control centre of the nervous system.

walkthroughs.body_html: Sense organs detect a stimulus. Neurones carry the signal to the brain or spinal cord. A response is sent back to muscles or glands.
A reflex is a fast automatic response — like pulling your hand from something hot. The signal travels through the spinal cord without waiting for the brain.
The male system makes sperm in the testes. The female system makes eggs in the ovaries. Fertilisation joins one sperm and one egg.
